book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: A JE'RA' U JACH TSOYIR U T'ɅN C'UJ TU TS'IBTA MARCOS

content: Yʌjq'uich'inyʌjir

Jesús caj wʌc'ʌs bin ich u chi'c'acnab u c'aba' Galilea caj u yʌnx chun u camsic bʌytʌc tu yʌn u chi'c'ac'nab. Jach ya'ab mac caj u much'quintob u bʌj yicnʌn Jesús rajen caj oquij ich chem a ti' yʌn ich c'ac'nab caj curajij. Tu cotor a mac ti' yʌnob ich ru'um tu chi' c'ac'nab.
Caj u ya'araj ya'ab ba' tu cu camsa'rob. Tu cu camsa'rob caj u ya'araj ti'ob:
―U'yex a ba' quin camsic techex. Caj bin mac quir u pʌq'uic u pʌc'ar ich u cor.
A mac caj bin u q'uich'intej ich u cor. Carique' caj u q'uich'intaj caj rub jun yar u pʌc'ar ich tam bej. Caj tar u ruq'uic ch'ich'.
U jer jun yar rub ich tunich tu mʌ' pim u ru'umin. Seb caj ts'ernʌj quire' jay u ru'umin, rajen seb caj joc'.
Barej caj naquij q'uin caj quimij mʌ' tu bin ocac u mots, rajen quimij.
U jer jun yar caj u rʌc q'uich'intaj, caj rub ich q'ui'ix. Caj ch'ijij caj rʌc bobosta'b ten q'ui'ix mʌ' ju ts'ajaj u wich.

U jer jun yar caj u rʌc ca' q'uich'intaj ich u jer u ru'umin. Jach tsoy u ru'umin. Caj ts'ernʌj, caj ch'ijij, caj u nets'aj u wich. Cien caj u toc ts'aj u wich. U jer caj u ts'aj u wich sesenta. U jer caj u ts'aj u wich treinta.
U'yex ba' quin camsic techex soc a wu'yiquex, soc a najtiquex a ba' u c'at ya'aric.
Biquinin cu camsic ti'ob

Caj ts'oc u camsa' ten Jesús caj u juts' u bʌj u doce camsʌwinicob Jesús tu yicnʌn, quet yejer a mac a ti' yʌnob bʌytʌc ti'. Caj ara'b ti': ―Biquinin ca camsic a pimo' bic tabar u q'uich'intic u pʌc'ar ich u cor?

Caj u ya'araj ti'ob: ―Je' u ts'ic techex C'uj quir a najtiquex a ba' caj u mucu araj ten C'uj ti' Cristo. Chen a pimo' mʌ' ju bin u najtejob quire' mʌ' ju c'ʌmajob u t'ʌn C'uj. Tu chen so'soc u'yajob camsa'rob.
Rajen, a mac a mʌ' yerob C'uj a cu yubicob in camsicob cu chen u'yicob cax cu yubicob mʌ' ju najtejob. Mʌ' bin u c'ʌ'oticob soc u yacsicob tu yorob soc u toca'rob ten C'uj.
Jesús cu tajquintic u camsʌwinicob a ba' quiri' mʌ' ju najtajobi'
Caj u ya'araj ti'ob: ―Mʌ' ja najtajex a je' ba' caj in camsajechex. Bic tabar ca bin a najtex tu cotor a ba' ca so'soc u'yiquex in camsiquechex?
A mac a caj bin u q'uich'intic u pʌc'ar ich u cor raji' cu q'uich'intic u yijir u t'ʌn C'uj.

Yʌn jun yarob mac ich tan bej tu cu q'uich'ita'r u t'ʌn C'uj, barej caj u yubob seb caj tar Satanás u taquic ti' mac u t'ʌn C'uj a ba' yubmʌni' soc mʌ' ju najticobi', irej u yijir a rub ich tan bej a caj in camsajechex sam.
U jer jun yarob mac, robob irob u yijir a q'uich'inta'b ich u tunich robob caj yubob u t'ʌn C'uj qui' yorob caj u c'ʌmajobi'.
Quire' robob irej u yijir a mʌ' tam oc u mots. Seb caj u toc p'ʌtajob u t'ʌn C'uj caj yubajob u tumtaj u yorob. Caj yubajob u chucur u pachob quire' u t'ʌn C'uj, rajen caj u p'ʌtajob u t'ʌn C'uj.
U jer jun yarob irob u yijir a q'uich'inta'b a rub ich q'ui'ix, robob a tu yubob u t'ʌn C'uj.

Chen a je' maca' cu tucric u t'ajar u ba'tac yejer u t'ajar u taq'uin yejer u beyaj. A ba' yʌn yoc'ocab cu pachtic, rajen bobʌsta' u t'ʌn C'uj soc mʌ' c'ucha'an yor u qui'quintic u yor C'uj irej q'ui'ix caj u bobʌstaj tu q'uich'inta'b.

A rub yijir tu tsoy u ru'umin ra' quir u camsiquechex a mac a caj u jach c'ʌmaj u t'ʌn C'uj, caj u ts'aj u wich cien, ra' cu qui' man tu tsoyir. U jer caj u ca' ts'ajaj u wich sesenta, ra' cu man tu tsoyir chen mʌ' c'ucha'an yor ti' a caj u ts'aj u wich cien. U jer caj u ts'ajaj u wich treinta, ra' cu man tu tsoyir chen mʌ' c'ucha'an yor ti' a caj u ts'ajaj u wich sesenta.
U t'ʌn quir u camsic ti' quib

Bayiri' xan Jesús caj u ya'araj ti'ob: ―Mʌna' mac cu yacsic u quib yaram u ch'ac, mʌ' ich yaram rec xan. Mʌ' ja wirej, cu t'ʌquintic ca'anan quir u yerc'ac'tic yatoch. Rajen a ba' cu camsic ti'ob irej wa t'ʌba'an u quib.

Bayiri' xan, tu cotor ba' a mucutaca'an tu cu bin u reyinticob C'uj baje'rer, ca' bin c'uchuc tu q'uinin je' u joc'ar u tajire'. Baxuc tu cotor mac je' u c'ʌ'otic ca' bin c'uchuc tu q'uinin je' u yubique'.
U'yex ba' quin camsic techex soc a wu'yiquex soc a najtiquex a ba' u c'at ya'aric.

Caj u ya'araj ti'ob xan: ―Qui' u'yex soc mʌ' ju tubur techex a ba' ca wu'yiquex. Wa chichin ca wu'yiquex u t'ʌn C'uj chichin cu bin u camsic techex. Wa ya'ab ca wu'yiquex u t'ʌn C'uj jeroj ya'ab cu bin u camsic techex.
A mac a yʌn u t'ʌn C'uj ti'e' u c'at u qui' najtic, C'uj cu bin u camsic ya'ab. Chen a mac ti', chichin u t'ʌn C'uj, mʌ' u c'at u qui' najtic, je' u p'ʌtique'.
Quir u camsic ti' u yijir a cu ch'ijire'
Jesús tu cu camsic caj u ya'araj xan: ―Tu cu bin u reyinticob C'uj ra' irej tu cu man mac cu pʌq'uic u yijir ich ru'um.
Rajra' cu wenʌn, rajra' cu yajar, jeroj u man u q'uinin cu yiric a ba' u c'at. U yijir a caj u pʌc'aje' ts'ernʌj, jeroj cu ch'ijir. Chen mʌ' yer bic tabar u ch'ijiri'.
Mʌ' ja wirej, u bʌjiri' u ru'um tu junan cu ch'isic u yijir a pʌc'a'an ti', cu c'ʌs ch'ijire', cu joc'ar u re'. Cu ts'ocar u ch'ijire' cu jobar yi'ij. Cu jobar yi'ij cu tar u wich.
Cu tijire' seb cu jaq'uic quire' c'uchuc tu q'uinin u jaq'uic.
Quir u camsic ti' u yijir mostaza
Jesús caj u ya'araj xan: ―An bic je' in quetquintic tu cu bin u reyinticob C'uj? An bic tabar je' in camsic techex? A ba' t'ʌnin quin wa'aric techex?
An ten bic u ch'ijir u pʌc'ar mostaza xib ich ru'um. Mʌna' u jer pʌc'ar jach ne mijin yijir mostaza.
Cu ch'ijire' jach manan u xit'ir u c'ʌb. U jer pʌc'ar mʌ' u ne xit'ir u c'ʌb. Hasta ch'ijir u che'er a jeroj, cu tar ch'ich' u c'ʌxicob u c'u' ich u bo'oy.
Biquinin Jesús cu camsic a jera'
Yejer jach ya'ab a je' camsa'bir u t'ʌn an ten bic a jera' caj u ya'araj ti'ob u t'ʌn hasta tu c'ucha'an yorob u najtejob.
Wa mʌ' yejer a camsa'bir t'ʌn mʌ' ju tsicbʌtej ti'ob ba', barej caj u toc araj tu cotor ba' ti' u camsʌwinicob caj bin tu junanob.
Jesús tu t'ʌnaj yic'ar quir u ch'enan bayiri' u yamin
Ra'iri' u q'uinin caj bin q'uin caj u ya'araj Jesús ti' u camsʌwinicob: ―Cuxex tanxer ich c'ac'nab.
Caj ts'oc u tuchi'tic a ya'ab maco', toc ti' yʌn chem caj toc oquij Jesús quet yejer u camsʌwinicob. Yet binacob u jer jun yarob chem.
A jeroj caj tar ch'ic yum yic'ar, caj tar u yamin xan, tan u burur u chemin, tabar u jurur u chem.
Raji'e', tan u wenʌn. Yʌn u c'anjo'r tu cu wenʌn ich yach chem. A'as Jesús ten u camsʌwinicob, caj u ya'arob ti': ―In wʌjcamsʌyʌjirechob, mʌ' wa ca tucriquenob? Tabar in jururob.
Caj ajij Jesús caj u t'ʌnaj yic'ar ca' ch'enac: ―Xurej, ic' ―quij―. Mʌ' a tar. A jeroj, ch'en u tar yic'ar, caj ch'en u yamin c'ac'nab xan.
Jesús caj u ya'araj ti'ob: ―Biquinin tu jac'saj a worex, mʌ' wa ja wacsmʌnex ta worexi'?
Caj u jach ch'aj ch'ic yum sajaquirob, caj u pacran arajob ich u yet camsʌwinicob: ―A mac a je' xiba' cu yuba'r u t'ʌn cax a ic'o' cax u yamin c'acnab cu quibicob u t'ʌn Jesús?
